risk_if_not_implemented: Without Intrusion Alarms / Surveillance Equipment, malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to natural threats NT-2, NT-3, NT-4, NT-5, NT-6, NT-7, NT-8, NT-11, NT-12, NT-13, NT-14; man-made threats MT-3, MT-4, MT-5, MT-6, MT-7, MT-9, MT-10, MT-14, MT-25.

compensating_control_1.name: Physical Access Authorizations
compensating_control_1.description: Physical access control mechanisms exist to maintain a current list of personnel with authorized access to organizational facilities (except for those areas within the facility officially designated as publicly accessible).
compensating_control_1.justification: Physical Access Authorizations (PES-06) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Intrusion Alarms / Surveillance Equipment (PES-13.1) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Intrusion Alarms / Surveillance Equipment (PES-13.1) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
